Re-measured: baseline is test/raise-hash-cost at 4a2296e1, candidate is this fix at 7160cc55. Improvements show as negative changes.

### Downstream report

Candidate `7160cc55` against baseline `4a2296e1`. Run started 2026-10-24T10:21:25Z, ended 2026-10-24T10:21:40Z. 2 VUs, 10 iterations per VU per pass (cap 60 s), k6 v0.56.0 (commit/50afb99947, go1.23.4, linux/amd64).

**Findings:** regressed steps 0, trade-off journeys 0, improved metrics 16, withheld metrics 0.

**Blast radius**

Changed routes:

- `POST /login`: handler (Server).handleLogin calls changed function (Server).issueToken (depth 1)
- `POST /books`: middleware (Server).requireAuth reaches changed function (Server).verifyToken (depth 1): every request on this route runs it
- `POST /books/{id}/reviews`: middleware (Server).requireAuth reaches changed function (Server).verifyToken (depth 1): every request on this route runs it
- `PUT /me/shelf/{id}`: middleware (Server).requireAuth reaches changed function (Server).verifyToken (depth 1): every request on this route runs it
- `GET /me/shelf`: middleware (Server).requireAuth reaches changed function (Server).verifyToken (depth 1): every request on this route runs it
- `DELETE /me/shelf/{id}`: middleware (Server).requireAuth reaches changed function (Server).verifyToken (depth 1): every request on this route runs it

Affected routes:

- `POST /users`: shares function decode with changed route POST /login
- `GET /books`: shares function hasTag with changed route PUT /me/shelf/{id}

*static analysis with go/ast, calls resolved by name, depth 2 from handlers and middleware, a function reached by more than half of all routes is ignored when looking for shared functions; misses dynamic registration, reflection, interface dispatch by other names, and cross-service calls*

**Not measured**

- DB time: not measured; the target exposes no database timing.

**Method.** Baseline run twice (B1, B2) and candidate once (C), in the order B1, C, B2, sequentially on one machine. Three runs give no confidence interval; treat verdicts near the thresholds as uncertain.

Thresholds in effect: a metric is a regression when the candidate is worse than the worse baseline run by more than 2 times the noise band (the difference between B1 and B2), by at least 20%, and by at least 10 ms (latency), 10 MB (memory) or 0.5 s (CPU). A step that passed on both baseline runs and failed on the candidate is a regression. The verdict is withheld when the baseline runs differ by more than 50% of the smaller one and by at least the same minimum, unless the candidate is clearly worse or better than both. A journey with a latency regression and a latency improvement is reported as a trade-off.
